component: Copies and Folders browser test coverage

quotes.text: `${identityProperty} should point to the nestedAccount's folder`
"the folder should still not exist on the empty account"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new test runs sent, archive, draft and template choices through empty, standard-name, alternate-name and nested local POP accounts. It directly checks identity destination URIs and flag movement, including that the empty target folder still does not exist. The popup helper waits for shown and hidden events. These assertions exercise selection and local flags; they do not cover Exchange flag locking, a real sent-copy operation, restart persistence or live accessibility.
title: The Copies and Folders picker test separates URI selection from folder creation and protocol behavior
